verdict.rationale: Anthropic Skills has a documented Skills API, with references to API pages for creating skills and managing versions, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer or runnable examples. The API reference links, llms.txt and markdown docs are static documentation and are adjacent at best, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
